description: §7.3.3 + §19.16.6 (S430 round 5, F2) — adding a `defer` must not change which programs compile. `let x` redeclaring parameter `x` is E-SCOPE-REDECLARE with the defer present exactly as without it (the defer lowering's `try` would otherwise have turned the illegal redeclaration into legal shadowing and the program would have run).
rationale: §7.3.3 rejects a let redeclaring a parameter in the function's top-level block; §19.16.6: lowering a defer does not change the meaning (or legality) of the rest of the block.
